'''''Arctotis acaulis''''' is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Asteraceae]] and is an endemic species found in the [[Cape Provinces]], [[South Africa]].<ref>{{citation
|url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:178512-1
|title=Kew Science Plants of the World Online
|accessdate=3 July 2020}}</ref>

==Etymology==
The species name ''acaulis'' means without a stem, from Greek ''a'' which means without, and ''caulis'' meaning stem of a plant.{{source needed|reason='Caulis' is not Greek but Latin.|date=March 2025}} The name refers to the species growth habit.<ref name="sanbi">{{citation
|url=http://pza.sanbi.org/arctotis-acaulis
|title=South Africa National Biodiversity Institute
|accessdate=3 July 2020}}</ref>
